metas.name: Sid the Science Kid
metas.description: Similar to Ada Twist, Scientist and The Magic School Bus, this show encourages curiosity and exploration of science through engaging characters and experiments.

metas.name: Daniel Tiger's Neighborhood
metas.description: A gentle and educational show that teaches social-emotional skills, much like the character-building aspects of Bluey and Doc McStuffins.

metas.name: Wild Kratts
metas.description: For fans of The Magic School Bus and WordGirl, this animated series explores animal science and conservation with exciting adventures.

metas.name: Super WHY!
metas.description: This show uses literacy and problem-solving to help characters, similar to the educational focus of Peg + Cat and Numberblocks.

metas.name: Puffin Rock
metas.description: A calming and beautifully animated series about nature and friendship, echoing the gentle charm of Curious George and Clifford the Big Red Dog.

metas.name: Sarah & Duck
metas.description: Offers whimsical adventures and simple concepts, appealing to the same age group that enjoys the playful nature of Bluey.

metas.name: Tumble Leaf
metas.description: Focuses on exploration, nature, and gentle problem-solving with unique stop-motion animation, similar to the inquisitive spirit of Curious George.

metas.name: Ask the StoryBots
metas.description: This energetic and informative show answers kids' burning questions in a fun, animated way, similar to the educational drive of Ada Twist, Scientist.

metas.name: Molly of Denali
metas.description: Combines cultural exploration with problem-solving and reading skills, offering a blend of education and adventure like WordGirl and The Magic School Bus.

metas.name: Rhyme Time Town
metas.description: Features catchy songs and helps children learn about letters and words, similar to the literacy focus of Peg + Cat.

metas.name: The Octonauts
metas.description: Embarks on underwater rescue missions and teaches about marine life, appealing to the adventure and learning elements of WordGirl and The Magic School Bus.

metas.name: StoryBots: Answer Time
metas.description: A continuation of Ask the StoryBots, this show dives deeper into answering curious questions with humor and animation.

metas.name: The Snoopy Show
metas.description: Whimsical and heartwarming stories featuring beloved characters, reminiscent of the lighthearted fun found in Bluey.

metas.name: Pip and Posy
metas.description: Focuses on the adventures and friendship of two young characters, touching on social-emotional learning like Daniel Tiger's Neighborhood.

metas.name: Xavier Riddle and the Secret Museum
metas.description: Travels through time to meet historical figures, combining history lessons with adventure, much like The Magic School Bus.

metas.name: Dot.
metas.description: A bright and energetic show about a tech-savvy girl who uses technology to explore the world, similar to Ada Twist, Scientist.

metas.name: If You Give a Mouse a Cookie
metas.description: Follows a series of interconnected stories with humor and relatable characters, offering a similar gentle narrative style to Curious George.

metas.name: Trash Truck
metas.description: A sweet story about friendship between a boy and his trash truck, with gentle themes and a calming pace like Puffin Rock.

metas.name: Dino Ranch
metas.description: Combines dinosaurs with family and adventure, suitable for young children who enjoy action and learning about different creatures.

metas.name: Go, Dog. Go!
metas.description: A fun and energetic animated series based on the classic book, full of doggy adventures and positive messages.

metas.name: Alma's Way
metas.description: Focuses on problem-solving, family, and community with a Latinx cultural perspective, offering valuable social-emotional lessons.

metas.name: The Last Kids on Earth
metas.description: While it has monsters, it's presented in a comedic and adventurous way suitable for older children who enjoy lighthearted fantasy, akin to the adventurous spirit of WordGirl.

metas.name: Octonauts: Above & Beyond
metas.description: Continues the adventures of the Octonauts, expanding their rescue missions to different environments, perfect for fans of The Octonauts.

metas.name: Ollie & Moon Show
metas.description: Two feline friends explore the world and learn about different cultures through song and dance, appealing to a sense of discovery.

metas.name: T.O.T.S.
metas.description: Focuses on kindness, responsibility, and teamwork as characters deliver baby animals to their new families, similar to the nurturing themes in Doc McStuffins.

metas.name: The Tom and Jerry Show
metas.description: While there's cartoon chasing, it's slapstick comedy suitable for young audiences and focuses on the comedic rivalry.

metas.name: Spidey and His Amazing Friends
metas.description: Features young versions of Marvel heroes working together to solve problems, offering a kid-friendly take on superhero action.

metas.name: Pocoyo
metas.description: Minimalist animation and simple storytelling that introduces basic concepts like colors, shapes, and words in a gentle and engaging way.

metas.name: Mickey Mouse Funhouse
metas.description: Musical adventures and problem-solving with beloved Disney characters, appealing to a wide range of young viewers.

metas.name: Gabby's Dollhouse
metas.description: Combines live-action and animation with a focus on creativity, music, and problem-solving through imaginative play.

metas.name: Hilda
metas.description: A visually stunning series about a brave girl exploring a world filled with magical creatures, offering adventure and wonder like The Magic School Bus.

metas.name: Arthur
metas.description: A long-running animated series that teaches valuable life lessons about friendship, family, and school in a relatable and humorous way.

metas.name: Dragons: Rescue Riders
metas.description: Focuses on young twins who bond with dragons and go on rescue missions, offering adventure and teamwork.

metas.name: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
metas.description: Educational adventures inspired by the iconic Dr. Seuss character, exploring science and nature topics.

metas.name: Creative Galaxy
metas.description: Encourages creativity and artistic expression as a young artist embarks on imaginative adventures, aligning with the spirit of exploration in shows like Curious George.
